title: Ziegler-Nichols PID Tuning
description: The classic method: raise proportional gain until sustained oscillation, then set P/I/D from the ultimate gain and period. It gives aggressive tuning that usually needs softening. Every controls engineer learns it first.

demo.code:
Ku, Tu = 4.0, 2.0
Kp, Ki, Kd = 0.6*Ku, 1.2*Ku/Tu, 0.075*Ku*Tu
print("Kp=%.2f Ki=%.2f Kd=%.2f" % (Kp, Ki, Kd))
print("then soften: reduce Kp 20% for robustness")
